phoneInstruction: Nokia N-Gage QD original 2004, orange/silver special color as photographed, dark grey rubber outer rim. Horizontal oval handheld 118 mm wide by 68 mm high, center PORTRAIT screen 176:208 = 11:13. Left four-way orange/silver cross-shaped pad with round silver rim, small circular joystick fire/select below right of pad. On RIGHT exactly 12 curved numeric keys four rows of 3: 1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9 / * 0 #. Orange and silver alternating keys faithfully as photo. Green call bottom left, red end bottom right. Thin selection/menu keys by lower screen corners, C/pencil upper right. N-GAGE logo below screen. Faithfully follow museum photo geometry and physical key boundaries.
